title: entandrophragma excelsum
intro: Entandrophragma excelsum, commonly known as the Yellow Fever Tree or Yellow Stinkwood, is a large evergreen tree native to tropical Africa. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Entandrophragma excelsum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory infections and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
